verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser ships a SaaS AI product (Visalaw AI), so a versioned API with a deprecation policy is a fair question here. The evidence shows no API at all: the OpenAPI probe found every candidate path returning 404. The 'Visalaw 2.1 Update' refers to a product release version, not a versioned API or a deprecation policy, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
